OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0

## Summary

I implemented a household-duplicate rule on `POST /api/owners`: a create is rejected with **409** when another owner already has the same `lastName` **and** `address` (compared case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Following the repo's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, I added:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean on the `OwnerFields` schema so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` exposes the opt-out flag.

2. **`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique`** (new function) — wired into `owners.POST.yml` as a `checkHousehold` step between the telephone-uniqueness check and `build`. It short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true; otherwise it normalizes (trim → collapse whitespace → lowercase) both fields and scans `OwnerRepository.findAll()` for a match, throwing `DuplicateHouseholdException` on collision. It mirrors the existing `CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique` pattern.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (checked) + **`DuplicateHouseholdHandler`** + its escalation YAML — turning the exception into a 409 `ProblemDetail` with `errors: [lastName, address]`, matching the shape of the existing duplicate-telephone response.

All three new `Cp10Tests` (reject same lastName+address, allow different address, allow with `sharesHousehold`) pass, and the full 20-test suite remains green.
